auditor_jane: Hi team — for the SOC2 field visit next week we need RBAC change history + KMS key usage timeline for prod (2025-01-01 -> 2025-03-15). Important: map each RBAC change to the authoring PR and any related incident/vuln ticket. Also need proof of emergency key rotations (who approved, when, and the rotation artifact). Can we get a proposed export & delivery plan by EOW?

maria: Thanks Jane. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Do you want raw log exports (S3) or a curated evidence bundle with manifests and screenshots? 2) Do you require any decrypted payloads or just key IDs/operations + timestamps?

auditor_jane: Curated evidence bundle preferred. No plaintext payloads are needed — key IDs, operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/Rotate/Create/Disable), timestamps, and approval metadata are fine. PR links + ticket IDs mandatory.

alex: We can produce a bundle. Plan: run collector to export RBAC audit events + KMS audit events, then stitch to PRs via commit ids in the change events. Example export command we will run: ```/ops export-collector --services=rbac,kms --start=2025-01-01 --end=2025-03-15 --format=evidence-bundle --output=s3://redwood-evidence/audit/1765558888/```

ops-bot: Export job queued: job_id=87345, owner=alex, estimated_time=18m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: Heads-up: mapping PR -> deploy -> service-account change isn't always one-to-one. We'll include a mapping CSV and a notes.md with confidence levels for each link (high/medium/low). Also flagging VULN-324 which overlapped an RBAC change on 2025-02-12; will attach the triage ticket reference.

maria: On emergency rotations: we keep approval emails and rotation manifests in the vault workspace. For evidence we can export the rotation manifest (signed metadata) and redaction-proof screenshot of the approval flow. Need auditor sign-off on redaction policy before we ship to avoid PII leakage.

auditor_jane: Redaction ok per standard SOC2 practice, just include a redaction manifest describing exactly what was removed.

alex: Sample log snippet we will include (anonymized): ```2025-02-12T14:23:01Z rbac.change service_account=billing-sa action=add role=infra.admin by=alice@redwood.com request_id=req-9f2b3d```

samir: Splunk query we'll use to source RBAC events: ```index=rbac_logs env=prod earliest=2025-01-01 latest=2025-03-15 | stats count by change_type,service_account,actor,request_id,ts``` — we'll attach raw query and result CSV.

alex: Also pulling KMS CloudTrail records and our wrapper logs. Sample command for KMS: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... --start-time 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-03-15T23:59:59Z``` — we will not include decrypted values.

maria: Delivery timeline proposal: preliminary bundle (samples + manifest) by Friday EOD, full export + linkage CSVs + redaction manifest by next Wednesday. Is that acceptable?

auditor_jane: Friday preliminary works. Can you also include a short walkthrough session (30m) the day after so we can validate mappings? :eyes:

samir: Yeah we can do walkthrough Thu 10:00am PT. I'll prepare the mapping doc and a short deck outlining our confidence heuristics.

alex: Noting retention constraints: some audit logs older than 90 days are archived; we'll include archival proof and retrieval logs where necessary.

maria: One more thing — we found an edge case where automated service-account reconciler generated a synthetic RBAC event (2025-01-20). We'll flag those so auditor can ignore machine-originated changes.

auditor_jane: Good catch, please annotate. Thanks team — will await the Friday bundle. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: job_id=87345 status=completed, files=rbac_20250101-20250315.ndjson,kms_20250101-20250315.ndjson,manifest.json size=1.2GB :white_check_mark:

alex: Received the export. Starting stitching process now; will push manifest and PR linkage CSV to s3://redwood-evidence/audit/1765558888/ and post link when ready.

maria: I'll follow up with the redaction policy doc and schedule the walkthrough invite. Thanks everyone. :calendar:
